# template Provider

A template Terraform provider with example resources and data sources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "template" {
  endpoint = "https://api.example.com"
  api_key  = "example-api-key"

  # Optional: tune HTTP client (defaults: 10 concurrent, 10 RPS)
  # max_concurrent_requests = 5
  # requests_per_second     = 20.5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Example API key used by the template client.

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Example API endpoint. Defaults to `https://api.example.com` when omitted.
- `max_concurrent_requests` (Number) Maximum number of concurrent HTTP requests to the API. Defaults to 10 when omitted.
- `requests_per_second` (Number) Average sustained API requests per second (token bucket). Defaults to 10 when omitted.
